data.narrative:
Science Corporation is a Series B biotech & health company that has raised $230M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public equities (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers, with particular relevance to 4 same-sector peers spanning Series B–C stages: Eikon Therapeutics ($539M), New Limit ($3.1B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-stage advancement, yields $437M. Peer-median valuation across the 4-company comparable set produces $3.5B, reflecting the wide dispersion ($539M–$10.3B) within frontier biotech. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; the target's revenue is not on file, precluding meaningful price-to-sales multiples.

The triangulated valuation range is $371M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.9B. The wide dispersion reflects structural uncertainty in early-stage biotech valuation: stage-progression is conservative relative to peer medians, and peer comparables themselves span an order of magnitude. Key uncertainties include the target's clinical or technical validation progress relative to Eikon (lower-valued, Series B) versus Colossal or Chai (series C, venture-backed multibillion valuations), and the degree to which frontier biotech multiples have contracted post-2023.
